player_action: I shoot my crossbow at the goblin crouched behind the low stone wall.
game_state: The wall is between the archer and the goblin, blocking lines from the archer's chosen corner to the goblin's square. Goblin is adjacent to the wall.
correct_ruling: The goblin has cover: +4 to AC against the attack. Cover would also give it +2 on Reflex saves against effects originating on the other side.

player_action: The orc is behind the doorframe. I hit it with fireball. Does cover help its save?
game_state: Orc has cover relative to the point of origin of the fireball.
correct_ruling: Yes. Cover grants a +2 bonus on Reflex saves against attacks that originate or burst out from a point on the other side of the cover.
srd_reference: Combat > Combat Modifiers > Cover (Cover and Reflex Saves)
common_wrong_rulings: Says cover never applies to area spells

player_action: I walk past the ogre, but I'm on the other side of a pillar from it. Does it get an attack of opportunity?
game_state: Ogre threatens the squares the PC moves through, but the PC has cover relative to the ogre for that movement.
correct_ruling: No. An attacker can't execute an attack of opportunity against a target with cover relative to it.
must_include: can't make an attack of opportunity
cannot make an attack of opportunity
srd_reference: Combat > Combat Modifiers > Cover (Cover and Attacks of Opportunity)
common_wrong_rulings: Allows the AoO with +4 AC for the PC

player_action: I shoot an arrow at the bandit; my friend the fighter is standing between us in melee with him.
game_state: Fighter (ally) is in a square between the archer and the bandit along the line of fire. Bandit is engaged in melee with the fighter.
correct_ruling: The intervening creature gives the bandit soft cover: +4 AC against the ranged attack. Separately, shooting into melee imposes -4 on the attack unless the archer has Precise Shot.
srd_reference: Combat > Combat Modifiers > Soft Cover; Combat > Shooting or Throwing into a Melee
common_wrong_rulings: Rolls to see if the ally is hit (not a 3.5 core rule)

player_action: The kobold is behind its buddy. I swing my sword at it — does the buddy give soft cover?
game_state: Melee attack against a target with another creature partially in the way.
correct_ruling: No. Soft cover from creatures applies only against ranged attacks, not melee attacks; the kobold gets no AC bonus from soft cover against the sword.
common_wrong_rulings: Gives +4 AC against the melee attack

player_action: Does soft cover from that crowd give the target a bonus on its Reflex save against my lightning bolt?
game_state: Creatures stand between the caster and the target.
correct_ruling: No. Soft cover gives no bonus on Reflex saves; it only grants +4 AC against ranged attacks.

player_action: The archer is shooting through an arrow slit. I shoot back.
game_state: Enemy archer behind an arrow slit in a castle wall.
correct_ruling: An arrow slit gives improved cover: +8 AC, and +4 on Reflex saves, with effectively improved evasion against effects that allow a Reflex save for half.
srd_reference: Combat > Combat Modifiers > Cover (Varying Degrees of Cover)
confidence_note: The SRD's improved cover example names an arrow slit and gives +8 AC/+4 Reflex/improved evasion; I'm fairly confident but recall it from memory, not the text.

player_action: I fire magic missile at the cultist who is completely behind the stone door.
game_state: No line of effect to the cultist; the door blocks every line.
correct_ruling: The cultist has total cover. You can't make an attack against or target a creature with total cover, and magic missile requires a target in line of effect, so the spell can't be cast at it.
srd_reference: Combat > Combat Modifiers > Total Cover; Magic Overview > Line of Effect
common_wrong_rulings: Says magic missile never misses so it hits anyway

player_action: I attack the goblin standing in the fog.
game_state: Goblin is in a light fog that gives concealment (not total).
correct_ruling: Concealment gives a 20% miss chance: if the attack roll hits, roll d% and the attack misses on 1-20.

player_action: The wizard went invisible. I swing at the square I heard him in.
game_state: Invisible wizard; PC correctly picks his square.
correct_ruling: An invisible creature has total concealment: if you pick the correct square and the attack roll hits, there is a 50% miss chance.
srd_reference: Combat > Combat Modifiers > Total Concealment; Special Abilities > Invisibility
common_wrong_rulings: Says you can't attack at all

player_action: He's blurred AND standing in light fog, so that's 40% miss chance.
game_state: Target has blur (concealment, 20%) and is in fog granting concealment (20%).
correct_ruling: Concealment miss chances don't stack; use the single highest. The miss chance is 20%.
srd_reference: Combat > Combat Modifiers > Concealment (Varying Degrees of Concealment / miss chances don't stack)

player_action: The rogue in the fog cloud moves away from me. I take my attack of opportunity.
game_state: Rogue is more than 5 feet inside a fog cloud (total concealment) relative to the fighter.
correct_ruling: You can't make attacks of opportunity against an opponent with total concealment, even if you know what square it occupies.
common_wrong_rulings: Allows the AoO with a 50% miss chance

player_action: We're both in the fog cloud, 5 feet apart. I attack the orc.
game_state: Fog cloud: creatures within 5 feet have concealment; farther have total concealment.
correct_ruling: At 5 feet the orc has concealment, so the miss chance is 20%.
srd_reference: Spells > Fog Cloud; Spells > Obscuring Mist
common_wrong_rulings: Uses 50% because they're inside the fog

player_action: The cleric cast darkness on the room. My party has no darkvision, so we're all effectively blind, right?
game_state: Darkness (3.5 SRD version) cast in an area.
correct_ruling: No. In 3.5 the darkness spell creates shadowy illumination, not total darkness: all creatures in the area have concealment (20% miss chance). Even creatures with darkvision or low-light vision suffer that miss chance in magical darkness.
common_wrong_rulings: Treats it as total darkness (5e/older editions)
Says darkvision sees through it normally, with no miss chance

player_action: The ogre can't see me — I'm invisible. What do I get on my attack?
game_state: Invisible rogue attacks an ogre that has no means to perceive invisible creatures.
correct_ruling: An invisible attacker gets +2 on attack rolls against sighted opponents, and the defender loses its Dexterity bonus to AC (so sneak attack applies).
srd_reference: Special Abilities > Invisibility; Combat > Combat Modifiers (attack roll modifiers)

player_action: I attack the invisible creature, but I guessed the wrong square.
game_state: Attacker against a creature with total concealment picks a square the creature isn't in.
correct_ruling: The attack automatically misses (the DM may roll the miss chance anyway so the player doesn't learn it was the wrong square).
srd_reference: Combat > Combat Modifiers > Total Concealment; Special Abilities > Invisibility
common_wrong_rulings: Rolls 50% anyway and lets it hit

player_action: I want to hide behind this barrel.
game_state: Barrel provides cover between the PC and observers.
correct_ruling: Yes; you need cover or concealment to Hide while observed-from, and the barrel provides cover, so the PC can make a Hide check (opposed by Spot). You can't hide in plain sight without cover or concealment.
